content: IBM Spectrum LSF integrates with Azure Compute Fleet for elastic, cost-efficient HPC workload orchestration. The IBM LSF Resource Connector for Azure Compute Fleet provisions and releases compute capacity based on workload demand. Extend on-premises LSF environments to Azure or run LSF-managed HPC clusters in the cloud, without changing job submission workflows. LSF manages scheduling, queues and policies, while Azure Compute Fleet provisions capacity across the VM families, sizes and purchasing options you configure. Key capabilities: Automatically provision and release Azure VMs in response to LSF job demand Specify multiple VM families and sizes in one Fleet request to improve the likelihood of obtaining capacity at peak Run fault-tolerant, restartable jobs on Azure Spot Virtual Machines and keep workloads that need continuity on pay-as-you-go capacity Preserve existing queue hierarchies, fairshare policies and license-aware scheduling Workloads include semiconductor design and EDA, genomics, automotive simulation, energy research and financial risk modeling. Download the Azure Compute Fleet plugin for IBM Spectrum LSF from Azure Marketplace and follow IBM's configuration guidance. Learn more.
